summary: Two MonthPickers: a field showing month and year with a twelve-month popover grid, one free and one limited to a single year.
use: Choosing a billing or reporting month where the day does not matter.
spec: `<MonthPicker label="Billing month" locale="en-US" bind:value={billing} />` initialised with `new CalendarDate(2026, 3, 1)`
A second `<MonthPicker` with `label="Report month"`, `minValue={new CalendarDate(2026, 1, 1)}`, `maxValue={new CalendarDate(2026, 12, 31)}` and `description="Only 2026 is available."`
Two `value:` output lines print the ISO date of the 1st of each chosen month
